en.t: For the Eight Ministries, see note 1 on page 2.

units.source_text: 八省百官行政之所，称八省院。

en.t: The place where the officials of the Eight Ministries carried out government business was called the Hall of the Eight Ministries.

units.source_text: 其正殿为大极殿，即朱雀帝为斋宫加栉之处。

en.t: Its main hall was the Daigokuden, the place where Emperor Suzaku placed the comb in the hair of the Saigu.
